Definition
[Graph manifold] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0215 1. ch31:31.54\group Collapsing 3-manifolds

A graph manifold is obtained from Seifert fibered vertex pieces and $T^2\times [0,1]$ edge pieces glued along boundary tori according to a finite graph.
